sentences.en: Surely the most curious of sources consulted is Mankind Quarterly.
sentences.zh: 当然，查阅最奇怪的资料来源是《人类季度刊》。

sentences.en: He is curious about how she will receive the news.
sentences.zh: 他对她会如何接受这个消息感到好奇。

sentences.en: The more you study, the more curious you will become.

senses.zh: 好奇的， 求知的；<衍生词> curiosity n .好奇心
